final: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), stats AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS overall_avg, SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM country_counts) SELECT SUM(cc.player_count) AS total_player_count, AVG(1.0 * cc.player_count / s.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(cc.player_count - s.overall_avg) AS average_excess FROM country_counts cc CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE cc.player_count > s.overall_avg
